Windows x64 portable test release.

- Automatic preview can finish a pass during continuous typing and pick up the newest pending edit next.
- Forest blocks use the same paragraph preparation hints as explicit TikZ drawings.
- The local compiler can retain a checkpoint after expensive TeX execution, including drawings produced by package macros.

Try sustained typing in the source pane and ordinary edits around a Forest tree or CGT board. This test build has passed the scheduling and paragraph regression tests and the package asset check. End-to-end timing on Forest and CGT documents is pending.

Run the portable executable after closing any other TeXquisite instance. The executable is unsigned.
